lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular nodes arranged in a semi-regular grid of vertical columns posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal spot alignments, forming a checkerboard-like lattice.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal ridges along the upper flank displaying a sharp vertical luminance gradient, creating distinct parallel horizontal lines.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A visible dark, horizontally-oriented notch or localized lesion is present on the lower mid-flank, approximately four spot columns behind the gill slits.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin shows a dense cluster of micro-spots with a higher spatial frequency than those on the lateral flank.
